text: Hello, I hope I've got the right number. I'm looking after my grandaughter Ellie tonight, she's 4, and I'm frightened to be honest because I don't want to get it wrong while her mum and dad are away. She has a temperature, I took it twice to be sure and it's 39.2. She's been tugging at her ear all evening and crying that it hurts, the left one I think, maybe both, she's not very clear. I read somewhere you should check their neck so I asked her to look down at her toes and she did it fine, no fuss, so I think thats ok? I gave her some medicine about an hour ago. I just keep thinking about all the things you hear about and my heart is going. Is this something I can keep an eye on at home till the morning or should I be taking her in somewhere tonight? Sorry for going on, I'm not sure what's normal anymore, it's a long time since mine were little
